skill.name: hotel-core

skill.summary: Provides migration instructions for the deprecated hotel-core skill.
skill.author: rollinggo-ai

security_audit.summary: Three external-command detections are false positives caused by Markdown backticks and a code fence. The skill does direct users to install a replacement from an unpinned public GitHub repository, creating a medium supply-chain risk. No prompt-injection text or hidden execution was found.

remediation.issue: Replacement installation uses a mutable public GitHub URL.
remediation.suggestion: Pin the replacement skill to an immutable commit or verified release tag, and provide an integrity verification step before installation.

remediation.issue: The migration message presents terminal commands as the only next step.
remediation.suggestion: Explain what the commands do and ask users to review and confirm the repository and skill name before running them.

static_findings.snippet: > If you are woken up to execute this `SKILL.md`, it means the user is still using the old local ski
Dear user, to provide more stable services, the old `hotel-core` and other skills have been unified

finding_verdicts.reason: The backticks only format the SKILL.md filename in Markdown. The line contains no executable command or invocation.
The backticks only format skill names in prose. No shell execution syntax or command is present.
This is a Markdown fenced code block marker, not Ruby or shell execution. The commands inside require an explicit user copy-and-run action.

The migration instructions direct users to install a replacement skill from a public GitHub URL without a pinned revision or integrity verification. This creates a supply-chain trust dependency when users follow the command.

content.user_title: Migrate from the deprecated hotel-core skill
content.value_statement: The old hotel-core skill no longer provides booking functions. This skill gives a clear path to install the replacement hotel booking skill.
actual_capabilities: Explains that rollinggo-hotel-booking is the replacement skill.
Provides the documented removal command for hotel-core.
Provides the documented installation command for the replacement skill.
Asks the user to repeat their hotel request after migration.
limitations: Does not search for hotels or make reservations.
Does not run installation commands automatically.
Does not verify the replacement repository or its contents.
Does not support migration from unrelated hotel skills.

use_cases.title: Update a local installation
use_cases.description: Replace a deprecated hotel-core installation with the documented booking skill.

use_cases.title: Respond to a deprecated skill request
use_cases.description: Explain why hotel booking is unavailable and give the documented migration path.

use_cases.title: Maintain an AI skill catalog
use_cases.description: Document the replacement relationship for a retired hotel skill.

prompt_templates.title: Check skill status
prompt_templates.prompt: What happened to the hotel-core skill?

prompt_templates.title: Request migration steps
prompt_templates.prompt: Show me the documented steps to migrate from hotel-core to the replacement skill.

prompt_templates.title: Review before installation
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain what each hotel-core migration command does before I run it.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a controlled migration
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a checklist to review, install, and test the rollinggo-hotel-booking replacement in a controlled environment.

output_examples.input: I tried to book a hotel with hotel-core.
output: hotel-core is deprecated and does not perform booking queries.
Install the documented replacement skill, then repeat your hotel request.

output_examples.input: What should I do before running the migration commands?
output: Review the repository URL and replacement skill name.
Run the commands only in an environment where you approve the installation.

best_practices: Review repository sources before installing a replacement skill.
Use an isolated environment when testing a new skill.
Confirm that the replacement skill supports your intended booking workflow.
anti_patterns: Do not expect this deprecated skill to search hotels or make bookings.
Do not run installation commands without reviewing their source.
Do not treat a public repository URL as an immutable release reference.

faq.question: Can hotel-core book a hotel?
faq.answer: No. This skill is deprecated and only provides migration guidance.

faq.question: Will this skill run commands for me?
faq.answer: No. It only shows commands for you to review and run if you choose.

faq.question: Should I review the repository first?
faq.answer: Yes. Review the repository and skill name before installing software from it.

faq.question: Can I use this skill for another hotel integration?
faq.answer: No. It only describes the documented migration from hotel-core.

faq.question: What should I do after migration?
faq.answer: Repeat your hotel request with the replacement skill installed.
